items.quote: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of
items.claim: The LORD appeared to the addressee and commanded them not to go to Egypt but to dwell in a land God would specify

items.quote: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father
items.claim: The LORD will dwell with the addressee and bless them, give countries to them and their seed, and perform the oath sworn to Abraham
items.action: will be with, will bless, will give, will perform
items.object: thee, thy seed, all these countries, the oath

items.quote: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries
items.claim: The LORD will make the addressee's seed multiply numerously and will give them countries

items.quote: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed
items.claim: All nations of the earth will be blessed through the addressee's seed
items.actor: all the nations of the earth

items.quote: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws
items.claim: Abraham obeyed God's voice and kept His commandments, statutes, and laws
items.object: my voice, my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws
